summary: FINAL LAUNCH (iteration 11) tested end-to-end. Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration11.py: 25/25 PASS. New per-table pricing formula verified for ALL six tiers (10→₹942.82, 20→₹1885.64, 30→₹2828.46, 40→₹3771.28, 50→₹4714.10, 60→₹5656.92) with per_table=79.9, base_fee=0, gst_rate_pct=18. POST /api/subscription correctly rejects tables<10 or tables>60 with 400. GET /api/pricing clamps to MIN/MAX (status 200, tables=10/60). 4-device cap verified: POST /auth/login returns max_devices=4; 4 distinct device_id logins give /auth/sessions.active=4; 5th login evicts LRU (verified test_cap_d1 absent after test_cap_d5 login); DELETE /auth/sessions/{id} returns 200 for existing and 404 for nonexistent. Razorpay fallback path verified (configured=false + fallback_link). All regression endpoints (auth/status, login, customer-login, menu, orders, stats/today, subscription, payments/config) pass. Frontend Playwright on desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844: Subscribe page formula-box shows '₹79.9 × N tables + GST 18% = ₹TOTAL/mo' with NO 'Base fee' string; breakdown-box shows N tables × ₹79.9/table + Subtotal + GST(18%) + Total payable with NO 'Platform base fee' line. All four payment cards (pay-method-upi/card/netbanking/wallet) render the new pay-marks-{key} container with the correct brand-chip count and labels: UPI=[G Pay, PhonePe, paytm, BHIM], card=[VISA, mastercard, RuPay], netbanking=[HDFC, ICICI, SBI, AXIS], wallet=[amazon pay, Freecharge, MobiKwik, paytm]. Screenshot inspection confirms: NO category SVG logos (.payment-card-logo) inside any card — they have been fully removed. Settings devices-card text reads 'Active Devices · 2/4' (max=4 confirmed). Mobile 390x844: brand-chip computed style height=20px, fontSize=9px (exactly matches spec); payment-grid renders as single column (gridTemplateColumns=362px); 15 chips total render without overflow. Default slider value reflects current subscription tables=20 → total ₹1,885.64.
